selection_process: Each next action written after reading previous measured feedback; no scheduled grid or automatic candidate chooser
objective: Find an additional internal vision-network weight edit that improves four-defect recognition
test_policy: Freeze a conversation-selected candidate before one final test. Previous final tests are excluded from search data. New frames come from familiar capture sessions, so no independent-job generalization claim.
method: Agent-chosen numeric edits executed by lab.py; no gradients or optimizer
